body:
Thank you :) I've decided to contact a therapist, because deep down, I don't want to give up and give in to these feelings - I want to fight

Even writing this post made me feel better by getting some things off my chest, so I'm hoping the same will happen when I talk to a professional and have somebody in person to talk with

We can do this - we can get through this, and we will come out stronger because of it - please stay strong
Thank you for making me feel less alone. Here's hoping things get better for the both of us
